name: atec Withdrawal Form
author: docjojo

sections.description:
Atec Withdrawal Form allows visitors to submit a withdrawal declaration directly on your website.

The plugin provides a simple form with name, order reference and email address, sends a confirmation email to the user, and notifies the site administrator.

Designed as a lightweight solution to support upcoming EU withdrawal requirements.

Features:

  • Simple withdrawal form via shortcode
  • Automatic confirmation email to the user
  • Notification email to the administrator
  • English included in the free version
  • Additional frontend languages available in the Pro version
  • Works with any WordPress site
  • No configuration required

Third-Party Services

Integrity check

Once, when activating the plugin, an optional integrity check can be requested from our server – if you give your permission.

Source: https://atecplugins.com/
Privacy policy: https://atecplugins.com/privacy-policy/
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to /wp-content/plugins/ or install via the WordPress admin panel.
  2. Activate the plugin from the Plugins menu.
  3. Add the shortcode [atec_withdrawal_form] to any page.
  4. No configuration required.
sections.faq:
How do I display the form?

Add the shortcode [atec_withdrawal_form] to any page or post.

Does this plugin require WooCommerce?

No. It works with any WordPress site.

Does it support multiple languages?

The free version includes English. Additional frontend languages are available in the Pro version.

What information does the form collect?

The default form collects name, order reference, email address, and an optional message.
